description: Testing CHP system with 6-bus electric power network and 8-node heat network. is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Zining Liu. A testing CHP system includes a 6-bus electric power network and an 8-node heat network. The heat network consists of eight nodes, seven pipelines, two CHP units, four heat loads, and a heat storage tank connected to node 5. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 38912 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
